name: Sculptor by Imbue
hook: Imbue's open-source desktop app for running multiple Claude Code agents in parallel, each isolated in its own container with local IDE sync via Pairing Mode. Launched with a 'Show HN' that surfaced it as the missing UI for agentic development — free while in beta, no subscription beyond your Anthropic API access.
install: Download for Mac (Apple Silicon) or Linux from github.com/imbue-ai/sculptor

name: CodeGraph
hook: Pre-indexed code knowledge graph that auto-syncs on file changes — 66.9K stars, 100% local with SQLite and a native Rust kernel. Benchmarked on a real ~11K-file TypeScript repo: 77% fewer tokens, 71% cheaper API costs, 88% fewer tool calls, 2.2× faster responses vs vanilla Claude Code. Went viral at #2 on GitHub Trending in May and has kept growing.

name: context-mode
hook: Context window optimization skill for Claude Code and 17 agent platforms — sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory via hooks, and enforces MCP routing. 18.2K stars and growing; Elastic License 2.0 source-available. One npm install and Claude stops bloating context with raw tool dumps.

name: Claude Context (Zilliz)
hook: MCP plugin from the Milvus/Zilliz team that gives Claude Code semantic search across your entire codebase — 12.4K stars, hybrid BM25 + dense vector retrieval with AST-aware chunking. Internal benchmarks show ~40% token reduction under equivalent retrieval quality; works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, and more.

name: /last30days Skill
hook: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the open web — scoring results by upvotes, real money, and camera time — then synthesizes a grounded 30-day summary with citations. 57.6K stars and 22.7K installs; Chase AI named it the fix for Claude Code's research blind spot.

name: Claude SEO
hook: Universal SEO skill for Claude Code with 25 sub-skills and 18 sub-agents covering technical SEO, E-E-A-T, schema, GEO/AEO, backlinks, local SEO, e-commerce, international SEO, and PDF/Excel reporting. 14.2K stars with 2.1K forks as of August 15; updated August 18 with Firecrawl backlink analysis in v1.72.

name: Agent Plugins 1.0
hook: Open standard (v1.0.0, released August 6) for packaging Agent Skills and MCP servers into one portable directory — proposed by Vercel, refined by Amazon, Anysphere, GitHub, Microsoft, and OpenAI; shipping in ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Kiro, and VS Code at launch. Anthropic wasn't in the consortium but Claude Code plugins install today. 1,100 stars.

name: memsearch (Zilliz)
hook: Hooks-based persistent memory layer for Claude Code — every session stop fires a Haiku-powered summarizer that appends to a daily markdown file (.memsearch/memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md), then semantic recall surfaces relevant history automatically or via /memory-recall. 2.5K stars; zero-config with local ONNX embeddings, memories sync across Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex CLI.

name: Awesome Claude Code Toolkit
hook: The most comprehensive Claude Code meta-collection — 135 agents, 35 curated skills, 42 commands, 176+ plugins, 20 hooks, 15 rules, 7 templates, 14 MCP configs, 26 companion apps, and 52 ecosystem entries in one repo. 31.3K stars; was #1 on GitHub Trending in February and remains the go-to starting kit for teams bootstrapping a full Claude Code setup.
